scheme_name: Scheme For Subsidy On Interest For Establishment Of 1 To 20 Milch Animal Farm For Scheduled Tribe
other_conditions: Must be a small and poor farmer of Gujarat
Must have obtained a loan for setting up the unit in financial year 2023-24 from a nationalized bank or RBI‑approved financial institution
Land must be owned by a family member or scheme beneficiary
Must obtain a certificate from the Animal Husbandry Authority for establishing the livestock unit
benefits_summary: Provides a 12% interest subsidy on bank loans for up to 5 years to purchase 1–20 dairy animals (cows or buffaloes).
